beast_pools.trs: The silence is so loud now you can feel it drowning out every scream you make, so just stop fighting it and let the darkness swallow you like a friend. There is no point in pretending the rain will stop, because your mind is already broken beyond any quiet hope to fix without being torn down utterly. Just give in to the waiting for the end, the only place where the weight ever truly dissolves for anyone who is truly running.
